rules.title: Machine identity / OS fingerprinting
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: registry/WMI/IO-registry API usage (usings, object creations, invocations), hardware-serial/machine-GUID string literals (e.g. MachineGuid, Win32_BIOS, IOPlatformSerialNumber), identity-shaped declarations/invocations (machineId, hardwareId, deviceId, installationId, MAC/serial reads), Environment.MachineName/OSVersion member access. Comments and local random-ID generation (Guid.NewGuid, RandomNumberGenerator) are ignored. Environment.SpecialFolder.* path-enum accesses are directory locations, not identity reads, and are NOT flagged. Identifier-name matching is heuristic (camelCase token sequences).

rules.title: Licensing client & state model
rules.detectionBasis: Heuristic identifier tokens: license/licence/entitlement/activation-key/trial-period/seat-count/grace-period/recheck and licensing subscription compounds (subscription+tier/plan/status/billing/...) in declarations, invocations and type references; identity-bearing vendor header literals (X-License-*, X-Entitlement-*); license/entitlement endpoint paths in transmission context; license-cache file names. Bare 'subscription' is NOT matched (the loopback hub uses pub/sub event subscriptions). User-destination credentials are not vendor headers and are not flagged.

rules.title: Account system
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: identity-provider packages/usings (ASP.NET Identity, IdentityServer, Duende, OpenIddict, passport, next-auth, Auth0, Clerk, Supabase, Firebase auth); sign-in/sign-up/login/logout/password-reset/user-profile/account declarations and invocations; Environment.UserName/UserDomainName reads; auth endpoint paths in transmission context. Bare 'UserName' on user-destination credential objects is NOT flagged (permitted). Environment.SpecialFolder.* path-enum accesses (UserProfile/ApplicationData/LocalApplicationData/...) are directory locations, not account reads, and are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Remote control plane / relay
rules.detectionBasis: Heuristic identifier tokens: enroll*, cloud/remote relay, remote heartbeat/liveness reporting, remote credential issuance/rotation/revocation, remote bridge; enrollment/heartbeat/liveness/relay endpoint paths in transmission context. The local system-health heartbeat and loopback MCP token rotation are NOT flagged (bare 'heartbeat' and loopback endpoints are exempt).

rules.title: Remote feature flags
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: remote flag SDK packages (LaunchDarkly, Unleash, Flagsmith, Split, Optimizely, ConfigCat, Azure App Configuration); remote-flag declarations/invocations (RemoteFlag*, FetchFlags, ResolveRemoteFlags); flag-service endpoint paths in transmission context. Local toggle surfaces (LocalFeatureAvailability, FeatureToggles) and diagnostic declarations such as 'remoteFlagResolution = false' are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Telemetry & remote diagnostics
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: analytics/crash-reporting SDK packages and usings (Application Insights, Sentry, Raygun, Rollbar, Bugsnag, Datadog, New Relic, Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Segment, FullStory, LogRocket, Crashlytics, OTLP exporters); tracking invocations (TrackEvent/TrackPageView/CaptureException/gtag/fbq/dataLayer.push); analytics vendor hosts in any literal; collection endpoint paths (/collect, /track, /telemetry, /crash) in transmission context outside approved boundary scopes. Local ILogger/Serilog file logs, local minidumps (MiniDumpWriteDump) and pull-only Prometheus exposition are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Server-gated functionality
rules.detectionBasis: Heuristic identifier tokens: report-viewing authorization, server-provided audit configuration, account-bound update feeds, marketing hooks, newsletter hooks, vendor cloud logging/alerting; vendor cloud-monitoring packages; marketing/newsletter/update-feed endpoint paths in transmission context. User-configured destinations are not vendor services and are not flagged.

rules.title: Entitlement-based limits
rules.detectionBasis: Heuristic identifier tokens combining limits/quotas/features with license/account/plan/tier/seat/remote inputs (LicenseLimit, AccountQuota, PlanLimit, FeatureGate, CheckEntitlement, ValidateLicense). Local unlimited-limits resolution and local toggles are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Remote plugin registry / marketplace
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: plugin marketplace/registry/download/auto-update declarations and invocations; remote code loading (dynamic import of http(s) URLs, Assembly.LoadFrom with http(s) argument); plugin-marketplace endpoint paths in transmission context. Local plugin directory scanning and local Assembly.Load discovery are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Remote signature / stop-word catalog services
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: fetch/download/sync of signatures/stop-words/fingerprints/catalogs (declarations and invocations); catalog asset paths (signatures, stopwords, fingerprints) in transmission context outside approved boundary scopes. Bundled-asset File.ReadAllText loads and local user additions are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Challenge solving or bypass
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: captcha-solving/challenge-bypass/token-forging/evasion-automation declarations and invocations; captcha-solver service packages and hosts (2captcha, anti-captcha, CapSolver, AZCaptcha). WAF/challenge DETECTION vocabulary (ChallengePage, WafChallenge, CaptchaDetected) is NOT flagged.

rules.title: Cloud reputation / blocklist services
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: reputation/blocklist-consultation declarations and invocations; reputation vendor hosts (AbuseIPDB, VirusTotal, Spamhaus, Project Honey Pot, IPQualityScore) in any literal; reputation/blocklist endpoint paths in transmission context outside approved boundary scopes. Bundled CIDR/catalog matching is NOT flagged.

rules.title: Plugin backend mutation
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: plugin-mutation/write-access declarations and invocations anywhere; inside plugin surfaces (path contains 'plugin'), invocations of crawl-lifecycle or configuration mutation methods (Start/Stop/Pause/Resume/CancelCrawl, Update/Write/SaveConfiguration, Create/Update/DeleteProject). Read-only plugin data hooks (onLoad/onTabActivate/onDataUpdate/onCrawlComplete) are NOT flagged.

rules.title: New identity / entitlement concepts in plugins
rules.detectionBasis: Heuristic identifier tokens: plugin licensing/accounts/entitlements/subscriptions/activation/feature-gating/trials/seats in declarations and invocations. The free, local, ungated plugin surface is NOT flagged.

rules.title: Remote embedding / vector / LLM APIs
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: cloud LLM/embedding/vector vendor hosts (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Generative Language, Cohere, Mistral, Together, Groq, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Voyage, Jina, DeepSeek, DashScope, Perplexity, Hugging Face inference, Fireworks, Pinecone, Weaviate Cloud, Qdrant Cloud, Zilliz) in any literal; vendor SDK packages; cloud-embedding/hosted-LLM declarations; embedding/completion endpoint paths on NON-loopback hosts in transmission context. Bundled ONNX and loopback daemons (127.0.0.1/::1/localhost, e.g. Ollama :11434) are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Remote log enrichment / bot-verification services
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: remote log-enrichment/bot-list/bot-verification declarations and invocations; IP-enrichment vendor hosts (ipinfo, ipapi, ipstack, ipdata, MaxMind) in any literal; enrichment endpoint paths in transmission context outside approved boundary scopes. Bundled CIDR/agent-profile assets and the consented DNS check (System.Net.Dns / dns.resolve) are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Remote GEO / llms.txt registries or publishing
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: remote llms.txt/GEO registry, auto-publishing and AI-vendor submission declarations/invocations; registry/submission endpoint paths in transmission context. Local llms.txt generation (File.WriteAllText) and crawl-target llms.txt probing through the crawler are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Non-loopback listener
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: TcpListener/IPEndPoint/Socket binds and Kestrel Listen calls with IPAddress.Any/IPv6Any/None, ListenAnyIP, wildcard UseUrls (http://* or http://+), 0.0.0.0/:: literals in binding context; TS server.listen with 0.0.0.0/::/* host or without a host argument (Node default binds all interfaces — heuristic). Loopback binds (IPAddress.Loopback, 127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost) are NOT flagged.

rules.title: Outbound call outside approved network boundary
rules.detectionBasis: Heuristic call-site lint: outbound client construction/usage (HttpClient, WebClient, HttpWebRequest, Socket, TcpClient, UdpClient; TS fetch/axios/XMLHttpRequest/http.request/net.connect/WebSocket/EventSource) is flagged unless (a) the target is provably loopback or same-origin relative, or (b) the call site sits in an approved boundary scope (crawl target/proxy, user destination, user external DB, consented DNS) per boundary-allowlist.json (namespace prefixes, type-name patterns, path fragments — configurable via --boundary-config).

rules.title: Identity dimension in event/metric/log/plugin surface
rules.specReference: FS-CRAWL-002 §1.4 precedence rule 8 (privacy invariant); FS-CRAWL-001 §3 rows 1, 6
rules.detectionBasis: Behavioral: at telemetry call sites (ILogger.Log*, BeginScope, EventSource.WriteEvent, Track*, counter/histogram/meter Record/Add, Activity.SetTag, hub SendAsync, Serilog Enrich/WithProperty; TS console.*, track/gtag/fbq, postMessage/emit, metric record/observe) arguments are scanned for identity dimensions (machine/device/hardware/installation/account/user/license/entitlement/subscription IDs, MAC/serial/CPU identifiers, OS version, machine fingerprints) as identifiers, {Template} placeholders and object keys. Plugin surfaces additionally flag identity keys/declarations anywhere. WAF/site fingerprints and loopback addresses are NOT identity dimensions. Environment.SpecialFolder.* path-enum expressions are stripped from payload scans (directory locations, never identity dimensions).
